```plato
    // The point a fraction `t` of the way along the Min -> Max diagonal. t is
    // unclamped. For per-axis interpolation use a point-typed parameter once the
    // interface exposes component access (see the note below).
    Lerp(self: IBounds<$TPoint, $TDelta>, t: Number): $TPoint
        => self.Min.Lerp(self.Max, t);
```

## Line 211

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/intervals.library.plato, line 211](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/intervals.library.plato#L211).

```plato

    // The point a fraction `t` of the way from Start to End. t is unclamped:
    // 0 yields Start, 1 yields End, values outside [0,1] extrapolate
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linear_interpolation).
    Lerp(self: IInterval<$T>, t: Number): $T
        => self.Start.Lerp(self.End, t);
```
